select p.id,p.admin_id,p.park_name,p.park_address,c.park_mount,c.park_spare,p.park_storey,p.rule_id,p.create_time,p.update_time, a.admin_name, r.rule_name, r.free_time, r.charging_unit, r.unit_cost from parking p join parking_capacity_total c on c.park_id=p.id left join admin a on p.admin_id = a.id left join rule r on p.rule_id = r.id
p.park_name like concat('%',#{parkName},'%')
and p.park_address like concat('%',#{parkAddress},'%')
and a.admin_name like concat('%',#{adminName},'%')
and r.rule_name like concat('%',#{ruleName},'%')
order by p.id desc
